lots.title: (1) Royal Salute 21 Year Old Emerald Flagon Blended Scotch Whisky, Scotland, 43% ABV, Circa 1980's (GB)
lots.what_it_really_is: Royal Salute 21 Year Old in a green (emerald) ceramic flagon, 700 ml, 43% alc/vol, base label 'Blended and bottled by Chivas Brothers Ltd, Distillers, Aberdeen, Scotland, Est. 1801', back label with the 21-gun salute text, and a separate lower label 'Imported by Seagram Australia Pty. Ltd., 32 Jasmine Street, Botany N.S.W.'. Seagram owned Chivas until 2001, so this is a pre-2001 Australian-market bottling; 43%, Aberdeen and no barcode fit Webb's 'Circa 1980s' but the photos do not prove the 1980s rather than the early 1990s. It is NOT the circa-2012 40% / 70cl Emerald Flagon that most auction results describe.
lots.what_the_title_misses: Only the Seagram Australia importer label, the tassel and 21 YEAR OLD hang tag, and a paper strip over the cap hand-inked 'LC7 0267' (purpose unknown). The title already states emerald, 43% and circa 1980s, so the key value points are covered. The title says (GB) but no box appears in any of the 3 photos.
lots.photo_evidence: Re-read all 3 photos and enlarged the base, back and importer labels. Confirmed: base label '700 ml', '43% alc/vol', 'Chivas Brothers Ltd', 'Aberdeen', 'Est. 1801', small numbers 2506931 and 2506470 (approx); importer label text read in full; neck shield 'Chivas Brothers Ltd, Aberdeen, Scotland'; 'LC7 0267' handwritten on the cap paper strip. Condition seen: small chip/lift at lower left of back label, chain-pattern neck band lifting and torn at one edge, cap paper strip stained, tassel and tag present. Fill cannot be judged (opaque ceramic). No box visible. The scan's reading is accurate; it did not over-read, but nothing it found adds clear value beyond the title.
lots.condition: Back label small chip lower left; neck band torn/lifting; cap strip stained; fill unknown (opaque); box not photographed.

lots.title: (1) Chivas Regal 21 Year Old Sapphire Flagon Blended Scotch Whisky, 40% ABV (GB)
lots.what_it_really_is: Royal Salute 21 Years Old, The Sapphire Flagon (blue Wade-style ceramic), 700 mL, 40%, with gold 'Chivas Brothers / Royal Salute 21 / The Sapphire F[lagon]' box. Back label: imported into Australia by Pernod Ricard Australia, Dulwich SA, and into New Zealand by Pernod Ricard New Zealand Ltd, Viaduct Harbour, Auckland; 22 standard drinks; bottled by Chivas Brothers Ltd, Keith AB55 5BS. Laser code on the lower back of the flagon reads 2012/01/17, so bottled about 17 January 2012 (SWA describes the Emerald/Ruby/Sapphire flagons as 2012 Diamond Jubilee releases).
lots.what_the_title_misses: The title calls it 'Chivas Regal 21 Year Old'; every label and the box say Royal Salute 21 (only the embossed 'CHIVAS' on the flagon body and 'Chivas Brothers' on the box). Chivas Regal 21 is not this product, so Royal Salute searchers may miss the lot. Also omitted: 2012 bottling date and NZ/AU importer labelling. The value effect is a modest search-miss on a common bottle, hence partly confirmed.
lots.photo_evidence: Re-read all 3 photos and enlarged the laser code, back label and box panel. Confirmed: 'Royal Salute 21 Years Old Blended Scotch Whisky' front label, foot strip '70cl/700ml 40%vol', full back label text, box panel 'The Sapphire F...', laser code '2012/01/17' with a second line beginning 'KS' (rest not reliably legible). Corrections to the scan: the code is on the lower back of the flagon below the label, not on the base; and 'fill into neck' cannot be judged because the ceramic is opaque. Ceramic and labels look clean; box present with no obvious damage in view.
lots.condition: Labels and ceramic clean in photos; box present; fill unknown (opaque ceramic).

lots.title: (1) 1962 Glenfarclas The Family Casks Single Cask Vintage 44 Year Old Bottled 2016 Sherry Hogshead Single Malt Scotch Whisky, Speyside, 54.8% ABV (GB) (166 Bottles Produced)
lots.what_it_really_is: Glenfarclas The Family Casks 1962, single cask, bottling date 28/11/06 (2006, so 44 years old), one of 166 bottles, 54.8% vol, 700ml, in the wooden Family Casks box with a 1962 plaque. These details match SWA's description of cask 2645 (bottled 28.11.2006, sherry hogshead, 54.8%, 166 bottles). The cask number on the Webb's label is not legible, so 2645 is an inference from the matching details, not a reading.
lots.what_the_title_misses: The title says 'Bottled 2016'; the label reads bottling date 28/11/06 and the back label says 'Distiller of the Year 2006 - Whisky Magazine'. 1962 plus 44 years is 2006, so the title contradicts itself. The other key facts (1962, 44 years, 166 bottles, 54.8%, sherry hogshead) are in the title, so the error may confuse some bidders more than hide the lot. Cask number is not stated.
lots.photo_evidence: Re-read all 3 photos and enlarged the lower front label. Read: 'Glenfarclas The Family Casks', 'Single Cask Highland Malt Scotch Whisky', 'Distilled & bottled by J&G Grant, Glenfarclas Distillery, Speyside', 'Bottling Date 28/11/06', 'One of 166 Bottles', '54.8% VOL', 'Distilled 1962', '700ML', 'Product of Scotland'; back label 'Glenfarclas, established 1836, Distiller of the Year 2006 - Whisky Magazine, www.glenfarclas.co.uk'. 'Cask Number' printed, digits faint red and NOT readable even enlarged; the scan's '4 digits' is not a reliable finding. Fill sits at the shoulder-to-neck junction (high, about base of neck). J&G Grant monogram capsule intact. Box plaque shows '196' with the last digit hidden by the bottle.
lots.condition: High fill at base of neck; capsule intact; labels clean; wooden box present.
